### Context
We're auditing and reorganizing the KooshaPari GitHub account (127 repositories) into a structured polyrepo ecosystem. A prior session deleted repos without authorization; now we NEVER delete repos. The goal is to consolidate, absorb, pause, or merge repos into proper roles with valid descriptions and preservation paths.

### What We Did

**Ecosystem Absorb Map:**
- Created `ecosystem-mapping/00-ECOSYSTEM-ABSORB-MAP.md` master map with 7 layers
- Categorized all 127 repos into disposition groups (retain/absorb/archive/delete)
- Target: 45-70 canonical active repos, 10-20 product brands

**Massive Repo Rename Campaign (26 repos):**
- 11 repos → `zz-pause-*` (long pause, code preserved)
- 2 repos → `zz-merge-*` (known merge targets)
- 5 repos → `zz-merge-unk-*` (merge destination TBD)
- 2 repos restored active (PhenoMLX, ghostty)
- 2 repos marked passive development (AAPI++, CPA++)
- 2 repos marked incubating (koosha-phenotype, terminal-fabric)

**Description Scrub:**
- Removed ALL "RETIRED — Code no longer maintained. Safe to delete." text from every repo
- Removed ALL "ABSORBED — no longer maintained" text
- All 127 repos now have valid preservation/role descriptions
- Zero archived repos remain (unarchived 17 repos)

**Massive Absorption (23 PRs merged into phenotype-tooling today):**
- DataKit, local-ops, Conft, Cockpit, AuditSystem, phenoUtils, localops-dup, AuthKit, infrakit, clapext, PhenoVCS, PhenoForge, Journeys, PhenoPlugins, eyetracker
- Plus 8 from yesterday: Benchora, PhenoProc, Eventra, Configra, FocalPoint, PhenoCompose, PhenoObservability, Tokn
- ArgisExtensions → phenoAI, KMobile → zz-mobile-mcp, HwLedger → PhenoMLX

**18 Absorb PRs Created (agents acting independently):**
- Agents created absorb PRs beyond what was requested — user approved ("those agents own those repos")
- All 15 on phenotype-tooling merged successfully

**ZZ-MERGE-UNK Master Audit (58 repos):**
- Completed 4-batch audit: ABSORBED(15), PAUSE(22), ACTIVE(23), TBD(6), MERGE(1)
- Report: `ecosystem-mapping/ZZ-MERGE-UNK-AUDIT.md`

**Current Agent Work (4 running):**
- Tombstone 6 absorbed repos (penguin)
- Audit 13 pause repos for merge targets (shark, snake, spider) — skip PhenCom, PhenoCompose from lists; Agentora last
- Merge Eidolon + PlayCua → phenoAI (squid)

### Current State

**What works:**
- 23 repos absorbed into phenotype-tooling (merged PRs)
- All 127 repos have valid descriptions
- Zero archived repos
- Master audit report complete
- Tombstoning agents running

**What's next:**
- Finish tombstoning absorbed repos
- Complete pause repo audits (3 agents running)
- Eidolon + PlayCua → phenoAI merge
- Remaining unassigned repos: NanoVMs, PhenoLanding, PhenoDevOps (skipped per user)
- 6 TBD repos blocked on forensic SSOT

### User Preferences
- **NEVER delete repos** — no exceptions, ever
- **NEVER delete forks** — 30-day waiting period
- Coordinator MUST delegate ALL work to subagents — never write code directly
- "Code no longer maintained" / "stub" / "no consumers" are NOT valid deletion reasons
- ZZ-prefix repos are for visibility ordering, not deletion targeting
- Passive development repos (AAPI++, CPA++) get NO zz prefix, block pause/delete/archive/merge
- Agents own their repos — let them create PRs even if beyond scope
- Skip PhenCom, PhenoCompose from pause merge lists; Agentora last
- User controls which repos get audited via deny list (adjusted iteratively)
- 1 agent per repo rule
